mapper.select: select o.customer_name as customerName, ifnull(sum(o.amount), 0) as orderAmount, ifnull(max(r.receipt_amount), 0) as receiptAmount, ifnull(sum(o.amount), 0) - ifnull(max(r.receipt_amount), 0) as unreceivedAmount, date_format(min(o.order_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as earliestOrderDate, datediff(curdate(), min(o.order_date)) as ageDays from ord_sale_order o left join ( select customer_name, sum(amount) as receipt_amount from fin_receipt group by customer_name ) r on r.customer_name = o.customer_name where o.customer_name is not null and o.customer_name <> '' group by o.customer_name, r.receipt_amount order by unreceivedAmount desc
